deployments_detail.use: Generative AI for flavor and ingredient R&D — consolidates recipes/ingredient data and suggests novel combinations human experts hadn't considered, accelerating new flavor development at lower cost.

Partnership with Brightseed using its Forager AI platform to map molecular interactions between plant bioactives and the gut microbiome, discovering new functional ingredients for gut/immune health. [Brightseed Forager]
AI applied to supply chain management and freight/logistics networks to optimize operations (referenced on the Q1 2026 earnings call).
ML/AI for flavor innovation, trading analytics, logistics optimization per CIO/exec interviews — no named production system or primary press release

Audio-based knowledge-capture system: frontline workers record spoken incident reports on an iPad/phone describing how an issue presented and was resolved, which AI consolidates into enterprise tribal knowledge.

AI applied to workflow and transaction processing across global operations to reduce manual touchpoints, errors, and cycle times, as part of a broader cost-savings program (per Q1 2026 earnings call).

Machine learning / predictive analytics to identify new customers, prioritize cross-selling opportunities, and predict customer attrition. CIO says results were 'extraordinary' with demand growing across the corporation.

ChatADM, an internal secure generative AI platform used to prototype 35+ applications, from automating routine tasks to interpreting video for equipment monitoring; built by pairing junior staff with domain experts to iterate daily.
